subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: Should TUI inline rendering be allowed to read absolute MEDIA paths from tool-result text in the host process, or should it only render trusted structured image/media-store references?
rationale: The feature crosses from model/tool output text into host-local file reads and terminal graphics rendering, which is a product and security boundary choice rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Render trusted structured media only
options.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks or structured generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

options.title: Allow constrained absolute MEDIA reads
options.body: Keep host path reads only with an explicit trusted-root policy, tests, and live proof for local and Docker gateway setups.

options.title: Pause under the canonical issue
options.body: Keep the open tracker as the product venue while closing or parking this draft until a maintainer sponsors the boundary.

recommendation.title: Render trusted structured media only
recommendation.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks or structured generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

likelyOwner.reason: The current TUI component history and adjacent image_generate work make steipete the best available owner for this boundary decision.
